tools.description: Find SEC companies by ticker, CIK, or name using the raw cache; it does not fetch or authorize unpinned companies, and unmatched queries return an explicit error.
tools.name: search_companies

tools.description: List SEC filings and exclusions for a company and date range; this does not pin or ingest filings, and unavailable ranges return a typed error.
tools.name: list_filings

tools.description: Read a paginated section from the pinned filing's verified normalized text; it does not summarize or silently truncate, and missing build output points to scripts/build_chunks.py.
tools.name: get_filing_section

tools.description: Retrieve ranked evidence from the pinned filing; results are evidence, not answers, and all numbers must come from calculate_financial_metric or compare_periods.
tools.name: search_filing_chunks

tools.description: Compute a supported structured metric from verified companyfacts for the pinned accession; numbers must come from this tool rather than retrieved text, and unavailable facts return typed errors.
tools.name: calculate_financial_metric

tools.description: Compare structured metrics across fiscal years within one pinned accession; values are calculated by calculate_financial_metric, never retrieved text, and missing years return typed errors without partial values.
tools.name: compare_periods

tools.description: Checks evidence IDs, hashes, metadata, and numeric assertions deterministically first; narrative claims are judged by the configured judge. Relevance is not support. Unsupported claims must be removed or reworded, never presented as fact. Evidence IDs are process-local and resolve as evidence_not_found after a server restart.
tools.name: verify_citations

tools.description: Preview and write a report containing supported claims and labelled partial claims. Unsupported claims are omitted unless explicitly acknowledged in the Removed appendix. The Pi extension must obtain ctx.ui.confirm() between preview and write; direct calls cannot bypass preview/confirmation.
tools.name: export_research_report
